The '''TF-4 Rampage''' was an industrial mining [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] available during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Favoured by criminals and popular on the black market, it featured heavy armor and aggressive engines which could be modified turning it into a rapid-attack craft.<ref name="swtor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The TF-4 Rampage was first introduced as a reward mount given to players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' who had been a premium player as of May 31st, 2018.<ref name="swtor" />
